capture_source: live capture 2026-10-27, S/4HANA 2025 on RHEL 10: strace of the gateway process during five SM59 connection tests of a type-T destination 'Start on application server' (program sapxpg). The started program reaches the local gateway over the Unix domain socket /tmp/.sapstream3300, not TCP, so tcpdump sees nothing.
notes: First frame a gateway-started program sends to the gateway: connect kind 0203, conversation ID at payload [46:54].

All five connections: [46:54] (32155195, 32156209, 32157218, 32158227, 32159235) equals the [40:48] conversation ID the gateway then uses in every 06xx frame of that connection, and the gateway echoes it in its 64B reply.
Contrast: a registration (020b, server_ni_init_client_long_progid.bin) sends 8 blanks there; non-blank is refused with 'REGISTER_TP conv id not initialized' (probe, issue #58).
Sanitised length-preserving: local hostname[:8] replaced by 'titan   '. [2:6] is 127.0.0.1 as captured.
Offsets are FILE offsets (NI 4-byte header included).
